paragraphs: Geographic Solutions makes online software for agencies in workforce development, economic development, education, corrections, human services, and unemployment insurance. The company frames that work as case management, labor exchange, and service delivery.

Its VOS Sapphire suite handles federally funded partner programs under the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act, along with job aggregation, labor market information, fund tracking, federal reporting, and unemployment insurance benefits. The Virtual OneStop line is sold on a SaaS basis under annual or multi-year agreements covering hosting, maintenance, and upgrades. A map on the site lists the client systems built for each state.

Founder and President Paul Toomey started the business in 1992. The company timeline dates the first labor market information system in the country to a 1994 launch in North Carolina. The software suite has achieved StateRAMP/GovRAMP Authorization. Geographic Solutions also states that it is currently SOC1 Type II, SOC2 Type II, and SOC3 certified. Among its listed affiliations is membership in the National Association of Colleges and Employers.
